name: armasu-route-security
description: Sort one Armasu Next.js API route handler by security risk, so a person reads the risky ones in full

other_users_rows.instructions: Does `code` take an id, handle or key from the request (params, query or body) and use it to read, change or delete a database row that could belong to a different person? Answer yes even if an ownership or visibility check is present; answer no only when every row it touches is chosen by the signed in user's own id.

ownership_checked.instructions: For every row in `code` that is chosen by an id, handle or key from the request, is there a check in the same SQL (such as user_id = ?) or in a helper called just before (such as a visibility or ownership function) that the signed in user owns that row or may see it? If no row is chosen from the request, answer yes.

spends_money.instructions: Does `code` call a paid outside service on a request (Gemini, Channel3 search or product lookups, The New Black renders, Amazon SES email, OpenRouter), directly or through a helper whose name says so?
